input.explanation: The division that failed is inside this repository, in `average_spend_per_item_this_month` (src/io_shop/spend_summary.py). It now returns 0 when the shopper has no purchases this month instead of dividing by zero. With monthly-spend-feature on, `render_spend_summary` calls this function, and `serve_account_page` reaches it through `_the_figure_for`. All of that code is in this repository, so no outside change is needed for those requests to render.
